core_question: Freeze only the O2.8-supported components (all three: outside-identity diversity A, second outside dimension B, within-support orientation C) and find the minimum OPERATIONAL resource frontier that closes the majority of the native-oracle gap -- with a numerically identifiable within-support estimator (NOT the underdetermined M2 Procrustes).
rationale: Both primary ROIs MULTICOMPONENT_RESIDUAL_CAPACITY_LIMIT: A,B,C all Holm-supported (8/8, p=0.0039); tested capacity set closes ~95% (ventral)/~90% (lateral) of the remaining gap; contributions roughly additive (small AxB), balanced in ventral, A/B-leaning in lateral (phi_C small but supported).
